program: Wrong-support counterfactual audit of few-shot segmentation
killer_experiment: Stratified wrong-support counterfactual: >=50% IoU retention for >=half of specialist methods on distractor-present strata AND indistinguishable from support-free objectness floor; both legs failing publishes the certification negative
primary_risk: Benchmarks may be too degenerate outside COCO/LVIS strata to separate model pathology from benchmark degeneracy
decision_reason: Cheapest decisive experiment in cluster; zero training; all checkpoints public and verified (PFENet HSNet BAM Matcher PerSAM FSSAM SegGPT); every outcome branch publishes; no published counterfactual audit exists

program: Blending-artifact detectability to synthetic-to-real transfer-gap law
killer_experiment: Fixed-content compositing ladder: Spearman rho(probe AUROC vs real DSC) <= -0.8 across >=5 arms AND artifact re-injection reopening >=50% of the real-DSC spread; either leg failing kills the law
primary_risk: Real DSC may be flat across compositing at fixed content (folklore wrong) - detected cheaply at the 3-arm MVE
decision_reason: Only fully causal design in cluster; answers both Stage-4 attacks (generator confound; detectable != used) by construction; verified public stack (SyntheticTumors DiffTumor libcom); adoptable hygiene metric

program: Decision-flip-rate audit of published SOTA deltas
killer_experiment: Pre-registered guideline-derived rule surface with null-pair flip floor and DeltaDSC calibration: excess flips >=30% of small-delta pairs beyond what metric delta predicts; <10% everywhere = decision-faithfulness certification
primary_risk: Auditable-pair sample may be too small; checked by zero-GPU desk survey of ~50 papers before commitment
decision_reason: Exceptional and cheap (inference only); non-vacuity evidenced by Stage-4 RECIST findings (kappa 0.67-0.81 at DSC~0.85); nomination gated on >=15 auditable pairs from desk survey; DiffTumor's 9 released pairs guarantee the MVE

program: Thin-structure fidelity floor of latent autoencoders plus downstream penalty
killer_experiment: Round-trip-predicts-downstream: no-generation AE round-trip survival curve must match width-stratified recall deficit of latent-generation-trained segmenter within +/-10% recall at matched compute
primary_risk: No floor may exist at task-relevant widths for modern f8 VAEs (cheap MVE detects this); conditioning could dominate downstream deficit
decision_reason: Floor-existence MVE nearly free (run opportunistically) but decisive causal arm costs ~33 A100-days for a datasheet/protocol payoff; lower headline density per A100-day than nominees

program: Label-cleanliness vs image-distribution decomposition of synthetic data
killer_experiment: Calibrated-noise erasure test: measured-calibration label noise injected into rendered-data labels closes >=40% of synth-vs-real gap at low scales with noise-model sensitivity band stable across 3 measured calibrations
primary_risk: Cleanliness share may be unstable across calibrated noise models, weakening the headline despite honest reporting
decision_reason: Cleanest falsification logic but costliest grid (~120 runs); share-type headline invites more argument per result than a flip rate or leaderboard reorder; protection honored via execution-ready design

program: Report negations as spatially grounded negative supervision
killer_experiment: Two-control information test: negation negatives must beat BOTH matched class-prior control and permuted-report control at matched sensitivity with pre-registered negation-frequency interaction
primary_risk: Negations may be informationally empty at organ scale (equal to class prior); gold spatial evaluation thinned by CANDID-PTX access restriction (verified this session)
decision_reason: Decisive controls but CXR-scoped payoff; credentialed-data engineering dominates cost; expected effect 5-15% relative FP; run MVE when credentialed pipeline exists

program: Convention-shift program: formalization audit detector and convention tokens
killer_experiment: Direction-of-harm dissociation on identical images: adaptation objective improves while true target-convention error worsens under pure convention shift (helps under covariate shift) with LIDC rater-noise specificity control
primary_risk: Three staged legs with independent failure points; only human-annotation budget in cluster; payoff requires >=2 legs to land
decision_reason: Highest ceiling (only methods-flavored survivor) but most failure points and slowest path to a headline; Leg-1 MVE (~3 A100-days) is first promotion candidate if a nominee dies at its gate
